cc:Work.dc:title: Size of the open items
cc:Work.dc:description: Horizontal bars, in margin votes, for each open item with a number: measured excess (solid) and worst-case ceiling (hatched), against the margin of 4.430.191 votes, on linear and logarithmic scales.

text.style: font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #5a5f66

g.text: Not measurable with public data (no bar): 1st-round counting curve; tests not run (A21, A23 to A25, A28); typed vote x recorded vote; coherent alteration before publication. What is missing to

text.style: font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #5a5f66

g.text: measure each one is in the list of open questions. Each bar is one item; there is no sum. The linear scale starts at zero. Ceilings inflated by construction or without power (for example, the

text.style: font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #5a5f66

g.text: recorded one for A32 and those of A31b and A32b) are not plotted; they appear only as text, with the reason (CHANGELOG, display rule).
